msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia optica-dh-vision-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of round tortoiseshell eyeglasses on a beige linen cloth with dried pampas grass from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia optica-dh-vision-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of round tortoiseshell acetate eyeglasses, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia optica-dh-vision-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of burgundy acetate eyeglasses, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia optica-dh-vision-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of black rectangular eyeglasses, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia optica-dh-vision-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Eyewear e-commerce photo of black rectangular eyeglasses with a magnetic sun clip-on, no logos from the reference, front three-quarter view, centred and large in the frame on a seamless cool light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp acetate, metal and lens detail.

IMAGEN 2 «p6» (formato 3:4, referencia optica-dh-vision-08.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a wall of sunglasses in many colours, no logos from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEF2F5) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «l1» (formato 3:4, referencia optica-dh-vision-02.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle photo: a young woman in a brown blazer wearing round eyeglasses and holding a mug, soft light, like in the reference, soft natural light, editorial, warm and inviting, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 4 «l2» (formato 3:4, referencia optica-dh-vision-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Lifestyle photo: a young man in a pink polo shirt trying on sunglasses in an optician shop, like in the reference, soft natural light, editorial, warm and inviting, shallow depth of field. IMAGEN 5 «b» (formato 16:9, referencia optica-dh-vision-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA C): Wide interior photo: the inside of a calm optician shop with floral wallpaper, small wooden shelves with glasses and a white desk, no people, no logos, inspired by the reference, photographed like a design magazine, beautiful natural light, inviting and tidy. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
